text:
Alex K: heads up — were rolling the RBAC change that splits the audit-export permission into export:bundle and export:stream. this will change who can request signed audit bundles.
Sam O'Neill: ok, timeline?
Alex K: todays deploy window, 17:00 UTC. noticed a couple of downstream impacts: 1) bundle signing currently uses a service key wrapped by KMS under the `audit-service` CMK, 2) customers run acceptance tests that validate signature `kid` and signing key metadata.
Maria T: important — if the principal that requests the bundle changes, does the signing principal change too? legal/customers expect consistent key material / kid.
Alex K: signing key stays the same CMK, but we set an additional metadata field on the bundle: `requested_by_role`. with RBAC split, that will now be `exporter:bundle` vs `exporter:stream`. should not alter signature but will change the bundle payload.
Priya C: customers will probably fail strict equality checks on the signed payload. a couple of SOC2 customers run byte-for-byte verification.
Jen S: legal note — any change to evidence format that could cause automated acceptance test failures should be treated as a change in deliverables under existing enterprise SLAs. we need to notify affected customers and offer a test bundle prior to full rollout.
Sam O'Neill: technical question: do we re-wrap or rotate the CMK? the rotation window for the `audit-service` CMK is next month. if rotation happens while customers are mid-validation, they may see `kid` mismatch.
Alex K: no rotation as part of this change. but we need to confirm our bundle signing metadata includes stable key id (we currently emit `jwk.kid` equal to the CMK alias).
infra-bot: deploy starting at 17:00 UTC — rolling update across regions.
Maria T: ok, plan: 1) add a compatibility flag in the bundle: `legacy_requester_identity` if caller principal maps to the old role — empty otherwise, 2) produce a pre-rollout test bundle for each impacted enterprise tenant, 3) legal email + 7-day opt-out for strict-acceptance customers.
Priya C: can we generate test bundles now for acme and medco? they already asked for a signed sample for FedRAMP-like acceptance.
Alex K: yes — will produce signed samples for acme, medco, and healthco. ill attach to this thread when ready.
Jen S: also capture change note for contract exceptions: if a customers acceptance test fails due to payload metadata, we treat as a compatibility regression and provide remediation/credits per SLA section 3.4. document time-to-resolution targets.
Sam O'Neill: implementation notes for eng: patch in signer service to include `legacy_requester_identity` header when mapping indicates previous monolithic role; update pipeline:
```
- check caller.role
- if caller.role in [old_exporter_role] then set legacy_requester_identity = old_exporter_role
- sign bundle with CMK (unchanged)
- attach metadata and publish
```
Alex K: also adding an acceptance-test cheat sheet for customers: what fields to ignore (timestamps, ephemeral tokens), what to assert (signature validity, kid stable across rollout).
Priya C: please include instructions for validating wrapped keys vs raw JWK — some customers validate the raw JWK thumbprint.
Maria T: ops question — do logs record which principal requested the signed bundle? we need audit events for `audit.export.request` with fields `requester`, `requester_role`, `bundle_kid`, `signed:true`.
Sam O'Neill: logs will include that. ill add schema fields and bump the audit schema minor version.
Alex K: small request — keep schema backcompat: new fields optional and documented. we should provide a schema diff file in the support portal.
Jen S: add a migration note for compliance reviewers. also flag FedRAMP customers — they may require re-approval if we change evidence manifests.
Priya C: ill draft the customer notif: TL;DR: benign metadata change, signed key unchanged, sample bundles provided, contact for help.
Alex K: putting together the samples now — will post when uploaded.
infra-bot: sample bundles uploaded to s3://redwood-audit-samples/2405123456/ (private)
Alex K: attaching sample summary: acme (signed, legacy_requester_identity set), medco (signed, legacy_requester_identity empty), healthco (signed, legacy_requester_identity set).
Priya C: thx — sending notif to customers in 30m.
Maria T: follow-ups: - eng to open a small PR to add schema docs - security to confirm HMAC vs asymmetric signing approach notes in the spec - legal to draft contract temp language
Jen S: noted. will prepare the contract addendum language and route to sales.
Sam O'Neill: will create a tiny post-deploy smoke test to fetch and validate one signed bundle per region. scheduling that now.
Alex K: thanks all. if any customer raises a failure, escalate to eng-security and cc legal. closing thread after 48h of stable rollout. :thumbsup:
